In Perth, the refrigerator unit on Woody's truck is threatening his last supply run of the year to a remote outback community, and he may not even make it to Punmu.

In Warwickshire, there is an early morning call out for Dave Crouch when a tipper truck gets stuck in deep mud on an isolated farm track; things escalate when Dave arrives on the scene to discover that the truck is still sinking.
